search_window.basis: Since prior directly read-back verified completed Food Line hourly heartbeat. Searched fresh and recently indexed local, provider, agency and government notices; excluded reports of historical events.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall watch; production nationwide collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss, fire, disaster or closure of only/sole/last/full-service community grocery
Emergency food distribution cancellations or suspensions due to storm, flood, fire, outages or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption immediately affecting access
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closed fire November 4 2026 United States (recency 2d)
food pantry "temporarily closed" November 4 2026 fire water damage (recency 3d)
coverage_notes.result: No verified new, nonduplicative qualifying U.S. food-access disruption since previous completed watch.

noteworthy_exclusions.reason: Official Nov 4 Indian River County, FL food pantry closed notice; undated publication and no evidence of abrupt shutdown, incident cause, or newly announced major loss. Calendar event alone insufficient for qualifying unexpected reduction.
November 4 Texas food pantry closure is posted as part of recurring planned schedule; not abrupt disruption.
Rancho Cucamonga WIC office closure was effective October 16 with alternate offices available; old and no new immediate statewide benefit interruption.
Nov 4 SNAP retailer stocking rule compliance deadline is not verified SNAP service or benefit interruption.
Eastport sole-grocery closure announced September 3; preexisting.
November 3 Wisconsin distribution cancellation already recognized in prior Food Line recall; duplicate, not a newly discovered event.

coverage_notes.limitations: Date-limited web search results disproportionately included calendar posts, prior-year incidents and historically reported grocery closures. The official Florida pantry calendar gives no unexpected-closure cause or dated new announcement. Search coverage is bounded and does not assert zero unindexed events.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No publication, review approval, production runner mutation, schedule change, or watch disabling.
